title: Compression candidate state diagram
description: The status column of one row in the state file's cands table, which compress reads as compress::Cand. The scan inserts a row as pending; compress moves it to done, skipped or failed; before planning, compress puts back in the queue (pending) the rows that failed only because of com.apple.provenance, every failed row with --retry-failed, and the rows skipped for having no provenance with --include-no-provenance; repair moves a done row whose file is not compressed back to pending, and any recorded file whose compressed data is broken to broken. A dry run, a failed probe (compress stops before touching any row when a compressed probe copy does not read back as compressed and unchanged) or a stop request leaves the remaining rows pending. The row goes only when the whole state file is replaced by a new scan; list --status shows any of the five.

states.description: Recorded by the scan with its size, allocated size, estimated saving, mtime and inode; waiting for compress.
Compressed in place; saved holds the verified drop in allocated size.

Left as it was, with a note why: gone, changed, flagged, without a provenance (unless --include-no-provenance), recently modified, open, directory not writable, not enough free space for the temp copy, APFS declined, or gain below --min-gain.
A verification or I/O step failed; the original is untouched and the note says which step.

Recorded by repair: the file is flagged compressed but its com.apple.decmpfs attribute is missing or invalid, its header size differs from the file size, or it cannot be read back. Nothing can be recovered; the note says why.

transitions.trigger: compress (not --dry-run, and past the probe) reaches the row
transitions.guard: precheck passes; the clone and the library's compressed form succeed; the copy is compressed, saves at least --min-gain, matches size, mode, owner, group, the other BSD flags and SHA-256, and keeps the original's extended attribute values and ACL; the access, modification and birth times set on it read back unchanged; the original is unchanged since
transitions.action: Restore the access, modification and birth times on the temp copy, rename it over the original, write status done and the saving.

transitions.trigger: compress (not --dry-run, and past the probe) reaches the row
transitions.guard: precheck finds a reason, APFS did not compress the copy, the gain is below --min-gain, or the original changed during compression
transitions.action: Remove the temp copy; write status skipped and the note.

transitions.trigger: compress (not --dry-run, and past the probe) reaches the row
transitions.guard: the clone or the library fails, or size, permissions, ownership or the other BSD flags differ, an extended attribute's value or the ACL differs, the hash differs, the times set on the copy do not read back, or an I/O error occurs
transitions.action: Remove the temp copy; write status failed and the note; carry on with the next candidate.

transitions.guard: the file exists and does not carry the compressed flag
transitions.action: Refresh size, allocation, mtime and inode and write status pending with an empty note, so the next compress run handles it.

transitions.trigger: repair --apply checks a file the scan recorded (adding a row if the scan made none)
transitions.guard: the file carries the compressed flag and its decmpfs header is missing or invalid, its size differs from the file size, or reading it back fails
transitions.action: Write status broken and the reason; the file is left as it is.

transitions.trigger: repair --apply finds a flagged file that stores at least as many bytes as its contents
transitions.guard: the same precheck as compress, allowing the compressed flag, and the same verification of the rewritten copy
transitions.action: Rewrite it as a plain copy with its metadata, compress it with the library, swap it in and write status done and the saving (skipped or failed with the note when a check stops it).

transitions.guard: the note says only com.apple.provenance differed or could not be kept, or --retry-failed is given
transitions.action: Clear the note and saving and put the row back in the queue.

transitions.guard: the row was skipped for having no provenance
transitions.action: Clear the note and saving and put the row back in the queue.
